text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Rice disappointed you, didn't 
she, Big Brother...?
choice_data_list: Let's figure out why we lost.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Rice disappointed you, didn't 
she, Big Sister...?
choice_data_list: Let's figure out why we lost.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Y-Yeah. You're right, big brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Y-Yeah. You're right, big sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will win next time... so, Big 
Brother... Please make sure you keep your 
eyes on Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will win next time... so, Big 
Sister... Please make sure you keep your 
eyes on Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A reason... Right, if I just try hard 
without one, I'll just lose again...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll figure out why I lost, and use it 
next time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if I'm useless, just moping 
around won't change anything, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will try to find out why I lost... 
And then... next time, I want to win...!

Afterward, when we reviewed her lost race, 
Rice Shower was, curiously enough, in 
remarkably high spirits.
